faq_heading: Ladner golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Ladner golf course home cost?
faq.a: Across 50 Ladner closings from November 2025 through August 2026, the golf course median came to $1,351,500, with the middle half between $1,169,375 and $1,528,250. All Ladner detached houses had a median of $1,340,000.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in Ladner?
faq.a: It is a detached Ladner house with a golf course entry under Site Influences. The seller’s agent decides whether to tick it, which is why the 50 sales counted here are a minimum.

faq.q: How fast do Ladner golf course homes sell?
faq.a: The median was 21 days on the market, closing at 96.2% of list, with 10% over the list price. All Ladner houses took 16 days.

faq.q: Which Ladner neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Hawthorne had 16 sales with the flag, Neilsen Grove 12 and Ladner Elementary 8 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

Every house in this Ladner search is a detached home that the listing agent has tagged as beside or close to a golf course. The most golf course sales were in Hawthorne (16), Neilsen Grove (12) and Ladner Elementary (8).

Between November 1 and August 31, Ladner recorded 116 detached house sales, and 50 of them (43%) had the flag. The median was $1,351,500, which is 1% above the $1,340,000 median across all Ladner houses.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a Ladner golf course home

items.t: Pace out the distance to the course and note which wall faces it. 50 Ladner houses were flagged, and the listings do not say how near each one sits. Hawthorne had the most flagged sales (16).

Stroll the course side of the lot for marks on windows and siding, and ask whether the seller ever had damage or an insurance claim. The typical house was built in 1988, which tells you how old the roof and windows facing the course may be.

Go through the title for any covenant, right-of-way or setback that links the lot to the course. The flag appeared on 43% of Ladner house sales, so ask your agent which registered documents apply on Hawthorne streets.
Return at a different hour, because mowers and play change what the yard sounds like. The median time to sell was 21 days here, so you rarely need to rush.
Judge it against similar unflagged houses: $1,351,500 for golf course homes and $1,340,000 for all Ladner houses, before you decide the course adds anything.
